7341.title: ACP lifecycle boundaries discard unfinished tool state
7341.rootCauseOneLine: Three ACP lifecycle reset paths discard active tool state before emitting completion and omit active text-stream closure.
7341.proposedFix: Flush active text and tool calls before resetting lifecycle state, preserving failed or interrupted status and event ordering.
7341.caveats: Repeated in two clean trusted checkouts by the same agent at the translator/assembler boundary; no live provider or UI verification.
